/how-it-works.title: How Heimdall Works | Lead Targets, Search & Teams
/how-it-works.description: Learn how Heimdall searches toward 10, 25 or 50 matches with API request budgets, related queries, deduplication, cancellation and reviewable results.
/how-it-works.heading: Find new leads.
sections: Connect your own provider key
Use Google Places for operational businesses without a listed website, or Foursquare to find business websites, phones, and social profiles. Provider fees are separate from ₹100.
Set a lead target and request budget
Choose a target of 10, 25 or 50 matches and an independent request budget of 10, 25, 50 or 100 API calls (default 50). A target is not a guaranteed count.
Continue across related searches
Heimdall fetches more pages and tries related category and area variations. It deduplicates Places IDs or website domains across the run while preserving filters. Relevance still needs review.
Follow live progress and cancel

See checked candidates, provider requests and matches. Runs stop at the target, budget, cancellation, provider failure or exhaustion of query variations. An in-flight request may finish after cancellation; partial results are saved.
Review match quality and permissions
Phone numbers may be duplicated, malformed or unrelated. Public availability is not marketing consent.
Save eligible results and work together

Named files, CSV exports and team copies require permission under source terms and applicable law. Saved files and exports include returned business details; provider permissions remain a launch-review requirement.

/google-places-setup.title: Connect Google Places API to Heimdall | Setup Guide
/google-places-setup.description: Set up Google Cloud billing, enable Places API (New), create and restrict your API key, and connect it to Heimdall. Understand separate Google usage charges.
/google-places-setup.heading: Connect Google Places.
sections: Create your Google Cloud project
Select or create a project in Google Cloud Console and link a billing account.
Enable Places API (New)
Enable Places API (New), create an API key, and restrict it to the required API and your server's outbound IP where appropriate.
Connect your key
Sign in to Heimdall, open Scrape → Google Places, and connect your key. The key stays in your backend session until sign-out or session expiry.
Monitor usage and billing
Google Places usage is billed separately by Google according to your usage. The ₹100 Heimdall purchase does not cover Google and Brave API fees.
Provider policy review
Google restricts storage and export of Places content. Full-result storage, CSV export and team sharing remain subject to provider review before launch.
Free API requests
Google’s global pricing includes 1,000 free Text Search Enterprise requests each month. India-eligible accounts have separate allowances. Google bills the account linked to your key.

sections: Your workspace information
Heimdall stores account and profile details, searches, saved lead files, team information, and purchase records to operate your workspace.
Sessions and providers

Google Places and Foursquare keys stay in backend sessions until sign-out or expiry. Queries go to the selected provider. Google sign-in, Razorpay payments, Resend email, and externally hosted assets have their own privacy policies.
Privacy requests
Contact kirankrish2019@gmail.com to request access, correction, or deletion. Shared team and transaction records may need to be retained as described in the policy.

/terms.title: Heimdall Terms & Conditions | Premium Access & Usage
/terms.description: Read Heimdall’s terms for Premium lifetime access, responsible lead discovery, third-party usage fees, service availability, payments, and refunds.
/terms.heading: A clear agreement.
sections: Premium access
₹100 buys Premium access for the operating lifetime of the Heimdall product. Access starts after verification of a captured payment.
Separate API fees
Google Places and Foursquare bill your own provider account separately. ₹100 covers Heimdall access only and excludes these usage charges.
Responsible use
Use public business data lawfully and respect privacy, marketing requirements, and provider rules. Results and uninterrupted availability are not guaranteed.
Provider permissions and launch review

API ownership does not grant unrestricted storage, export, resale or sharing rights. Full Google result storage, export and sharing remain subject to provider restrictions. The broader lead-discovery use remains subject to provider review. Heimdall is independent, not endorsed by these providers.

/refund.description: Request help with a Heimdall payment or refund. Approved refunds are processed within 7 days to the original payment method; bank credit timing may vary.

sections: Request a refund

Processing timeline
Approved refunds are processed within 7 days to the original payment method. Normal bank credit can take 5–7 working days after initiation.
Separate provider charges
Heimdall refunds only cover payments made to Heimdall. Google Places and Foursquare API charges are billed separately by those providers.

/foursquare-setup.title: Connect Foursquare Places | Heimdall
/foursquare-setup.description: Create a Foursquare Places key, connect it to Heimdall, and search local businesses. See free calls and separate provider billing.
/foursquare-setup.heading: Connect Foursquare
sections: Create a Service API key
Create a Places project in the Foursquare developer console and generate a Service API key.
Connect in Heimdall
Choose Foursquare Business Discovery in Scrape and paste your key.
Free API calls
Foursquare publishes 500 free Pro calls. Your provider bills your own account for usage charges.
